# prismacloudcompute_collection (Data Source)

Collections are predefined filters that let you group related resources together. They can be used to scope policy rules and segment data/views in the Console UI and the Prisma Cloud API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Collection name. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (Set of String) List of account IDs.
- `app_ids` (Set of String) List of application IDs.
- `clusters` (Set of String) List of Kubernetes cluster names.
- `color` (String) Hexadecimal representation of the collection's color value.
- `containers` (Set of String) List of containers.
- `description` (String) Description of the collection.
- `functions` (Set of String) List of serverless functions.
- `hosts` (Set of String) List of hosts.
- `images` (Set of String) List of images.
- `labels` (Set of String) List of labels.
- `namespaces` (Set of String) List of Kubernetes namespaces.

### Read-Only

- `modified` (String) Date and time that the collection was last modified.
- `owner` (String) User who created or last modified the collection.
- `prisma` (Boolean) Indicates whether this collection originated from Prisma Cloud.
- `system` (Boolean) Indicates whether this collection was created by a user (true) or the system (false).
